youtube.title: Napoleon tried to hunt rabbits. Thousands hunted him back 🐇 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon Bonaparte beat half of Europe… then lost to a field of bunnies. 🐇

The rabbits were tame and thought the emperor was bringing dinner.

Comment the reply YOU would've sent the rabbits 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the famous (and probably embellished) 1807 story: after the Treaty of Tilsit, Berthier set up a rabbit hunt for Napoleon with farm-raised rabbits, which charged at him expecting food and chased him back to his carriage.

#napoleon #napoleonbonaparte #weirdhistory #funnyhistory #frenchhistory #historymemes #shorts
